title: City of Melbourne's urban forest: every tree the City manages, with its species, diameter, planting year and useful life expectancy
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset trees-with-species-and-dimensions-urban-forest
credit: Urban Forest: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the dataset's metadata: license CC BY, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-12)
citation: City of Melbourne, Trees, with species and dimensions (Urban Forest), https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/trees-with-species-and-dimensions-urban-forest/
format: JSON records: com_id, common_name, scientific_name, genus, family, diameter_breast_height (cm), year_planted, date_planted, age_description, useful_life_expectency (a class in years, as an arborist assessed it), useful_life_expectency_value, precinct, located_in (Street or Park), latitude, longitude, easting and northing (MGA zone 55).
coverage: The trees the City of Melbourne manages in its streets and parks: 82,064 (dataset modified 2025-09-22; checked 2026-11-12).
